roles.title: Staff Product Manager, New Models & Markets

bullets: Own the next phase of Grow's strategic payor partnership roadmap, including deepening existing partnerships.
Define the product vision and MVP for Grow's next generation EAP offering, building on our existing early customers and first generation offering.
Design for the full pathway a client, employer, or payor takes through Grow's systems — thinking at the systems level, not just the feature level.
Partner directly with our VP of Corporate Development to shape how Grow approaches new payor and employer partnership models.
Navigate the tactical complexity of authorizations, contracts, and payor requirements as part of building something that's still early at Grow.
